svg.title: Infinite world streaming
svg.desc: World::update() — a pool of worker threads generates and meshes 16×256×16 chunks around the player.
svg.text: World::update() — a pool of worker threads generates and meshes 16×256×16 chunks around the player.
render distance R (meshed up to R + 0.5)
One priority queue, ordered by distance to the player.
A chunk is meshed once its 8 neighbours exist, so
Mesh jobs read shared_ptr<const Chunk>: no locks.
Unmodified chunks are simply dropped and regenerated.
shown with R = 6 and 6 workers · default render distance is 20 chunks
